capabilities: Suggest language identifiers after opening backtick or tilde fences
Insert canonical languages for aliases like py, js, and ts
Fuzzy-match and prioritize recently used language identifiers
Change or clear the language of the code block containing the cursor
Insert empty code blocks or wrap selections via a command and hotkey
extras: Warns when another enabled plugin (Codeblock Completer or the older Code Language Completer) provides conflicting code-block suggestions; includes manual installation steps and developer release instructions.
intentEvidence: This plugin is based on stanley-910/obsidian-code-language-completer, originally released under the MIT License. This fork includes substantial reliability, usability, testing, and release-tooling updates.
problem: Obsidian offers no reliable suggestions for code-fence language identifiers, so writers must type and remember them by hand.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on stanley-910/obsidian-code-language-completer, originally released under the MIT License.

summary: Autocomplete plugin that suggests and completes language identifiers for Markdown code fences, with aliases, fuzzy matching and custom mappings.
